sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Small Things, Big Help is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Howdy, brother! How you been? Alright, we'll chat later. Business first! I found out there are some fuel stashes in the forest, not far from the cliffs. At the very least, there are barrels out there. Worth checking! Fuel is never a bad thing to have, especially with a buyer as hungry as Mechanic. He bought my entire last shipment. So, go look for those barrels and mark them with beacons. I heard about three stashes. That'll be enough for me."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and mark the first fuel stash with an MS2000 Marker on Woods
- Locate and mark the second fuel stash with an MS2000 Marker on Woods
- Locate and mark the third fuel stash with an MS2000 Marker on Woods

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Ragman Rep +0.1
- 80,000 Roubles
  - 84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 3× Energy-saving lamp
"Signal's coming through, my guys are ready to move out!"

sections.heading: Initial Equipment
sections.text:
| Item Name | Amount | Notes |
| MS2000 Marker | 3 | This item is placed at the fuel stashes. When placed, the item is removed from the players' inventory. |

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in Raid | Notes |
| MS2000 Marker | 3 | Required | N/A | This item is placed at the stashes. When placed, the item is removed from the players' inventory. |
In this quest you have to find and mark 3 fuel stashes with MS2000 markers on Woods.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- You can buy MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
- It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.
- The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work
